title: Weak lensing catalogues and cosmology with UNIONS, Euclid and SPT
author: Cail Daley
description: How large weak-lensing analyses are done today, through Euclid × SPT-3G CMB lensing and UNIONS cosmic shear, and where simulation pipelines take them.

sections.title: Opening
sections.outline: Weak lensing catalogues and cosmology with UNIONS, Euclid and SPT.

sections.title: Euclid × SPT-3G
sections.outline: Euclid shear and clustering crossed with SPT-3G CMB lensing: the overlap, the pipeline and its mocks, the blinded TR1 data vector, the lens ratio as a check on shear calibration, blinded posteriors against ACT DR6, and where SPT-3G is tighter.

sections.title: Backup
sections.outline: The blinding rehearsal on a mock, the systematics-template crosses, the FLASK covariance, and Marco Gatti's ACT DR6 forward model.
